overview.node_sim: Built-in simulator (nothing is sent to a keyboard)
overview.base_layer_help: Highlighted keys do something other than their legend. Change them on the Keymap page.
overview.poll_help: How often the keyboard reports to the computer. The keyboard restarts after a change and reconnects by itself.
overview.poll_confirm: Set the poll rate to %1 kHz? The keyboard restarts and is unavailable for a few seconds.
overview.win_lock_help: Keys blocked while win lock is on (Fn + Win toggles it on the board).
overview.profiles_help: The board has no onboard profiles: profiles are saved on this computer and written to the keyboard when applied.
overview.apply_profile_text: These settings of the keyboard change; everything else stays as it is.
overview.profile_overwrite: A profile named %1 already exists. Replace it with the current settings?
overview.delete_profile: Delete the profile %1 from this computer? The keyboard is not changed.
overview.backups_help: Before the first change of every session the whole configuration is saved automatically (the last 20 are kept).
overview.restore_text: Write the settings saved in %1 back to the keyboard? These settings change:
overview.factory_help: Resets lighting, keymap, macros, advanced keys, trigger settings and SOCD to factory values.
overview.factory_confirm: Reset the keyboard to factory settings? All your settings on the board are lost. A backup is saved automatically before the first change of this session; restore it from the list above if needed.
